info.title: Paceful Partner API
info.description:
The Paceful Partner API enables you to integrate Emotional Readiness Scores into your product — dating apps, therapy platforms, workplace tools, and more.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except sandbox and health) require a partner API key in the `X-API-Key` header.

```
X-API-Key: pk_live_your_key_here
```

Get your API key at [paceful.app/partners/signup](https://paceful.app/partners/signup).

## Rate Limiting

Rate limits are applied per API key. Check response headers:

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Max requests per hour |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests remaining |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when window resets |

Exceeded limits return `429 Too Many Requests`.

## Sandbox Mode

Use a sandbox API key (`pk_sandbox_...`) for testing. Sandbox requests:
- Return deterministic realistic data
- Do not persist to production
- Do not count against rate limits

## Emotional Readiness Score Dimensions

The score is computed from 5 weighted dimensions:

| Dimension | Weight | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| Emotional Stability | 25% | Mood variance, emotional regulation |
| Self Reflection | 15% | Self-awareness, pattern recognition |
| Coping Capacity | 20% | Healthy coping, problem-solving |
| Behavioral Engagement | 15% | Activity levels, routine consistency |
| Social Readiness | 25% | Openness to relationships, trust |

## Score Stages

| Stage | Score Range | Label |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| Healing | 0–39 | Not Ready |
| Rebuilding | 40–74 | Rebuilding |
| Ready | 75–100 | Ready |

Analyze unstructured text — journal entries, session notes, chat transcripts — and extract an Emotional Readiness Score using AI. Supports confidence scoring and signal extraction.

**Minimum text length:** 20 characters  
**Maximum text length:** 10,000 characters

example.text: Today was hard but I handled it better than I would have a few months ago. When my plans got canceled, I caught myself before spiraling. I've been doing breathing exercises and they actually help. I'm starting to recognize my patterns and I think I'm ready to start putting myself out there again.

self_reflection.reasoning: Self-reflection capacity indicators are strong. Key signals: recognize my patterns, handled it better than before.

coping_capacity.label: high
coping_capacity.reasoning: Coping capacity indicators are strong. Key signals: breathing exercises and they actually help.

post.description:
Analyze up to 20 text entries and compute a composite Emotional Readiness Score with trend detection. Entries are time-weighted — more recent entries contribute more to the composite score.

**Max entries per request:** 20

entries.text: Feeling overwhelmed today. Couldn't focus at all.
Better today. Applied for that promotion I've been thinking about.
Great weekend hiking with friends. Felt present and happy.

post.description:
Analyze text using a vertical-specific risk engine. Returns standard Emotional Readiness Score dimensions plus a `vertical_analysis` block with industry-specific risk signals.

**Supported verticals:**
- `dating` — Post-breakup readiness, attachment signals
- `mental_health` — Between-session monitoring, crisis risk
- `workplace` — Burnout, attrition risk, return-to-work readiness
- `gambling` — Problem gambling signals, duty-of-care interventions
- `insurance` — Emotional risk indicators for policy underwriting

example.text: I keep losing but I know the next session will turn it around. I've borrowed money to keep playing. I can't tell my family.

put.description: Update your partner defaults. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated. Changes take effect immediately on subsequent API calls.

get.description: Returns all webhook registrations for your partner account.

post.description:
Register a URL to receive real-time event notifications. Paceful signs each webhook payload with an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the `X-Paceful-Signature` header.

**Supported events:**
- `ers.stage_changed` — User transitions between Healing / Rebuilding / Ready
- `ers.score_threshold` — Score crosses a configured threshold
- `mood.critical` — 3+ consecutive low mood scores
- `mood.logged` — Any mood entry is logged
- `journal.created` — A journal entry is submitted for analysis

delete.description: Deregister a webhook. Events will no longer be delivered to this URL.

post.description:
Analyze text and receive an Emotional Readiness Score without an API key. Rate limited to 5 requests per session and 20 per IP per day. Identical response shape to `POST /api/v1/assess/analyze`.

Perfect for embedding a demo on your site or testing the API before signing up.

example.text: I've been journaling every morning and I feel like I'm finally processing the breakup. I'm not ready to date yet but I'm open to making new friends.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
Your partner API key. Get one at [paceful.app/partners/signup](https://paceful.app/partners/signup).
- Production keys: `pk_live_...`
- Sandbox keys: `pk_sandbox_...`

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the rate limit window resets

ResponseConfig.description: Per-request response formatting. Overrides your partner defaults for this call only.

verbosity.description: `minimal` — score + label only. `standard` — adds reasoning + signals. `clinical` — full detail with recommended actions.

tone.description: Tone of reasoning text when verbosity is standard or clinical.

traffic_light_thresholds.description: Custom thresholds for traffic_light format. Default: red ≤33, yellow ≤66, green >66.

include_trend.description: Include trend data when historical scores are available.

score.description: Dimension score 0–100 (or formatted string when score_format is not numerical)

reasoning.description: Present when verbosity is standard or clinical

top_signals.description: Text excerpts supporting this score. Present when include_signals is true.

timestamp.description: When this entry was written. Used for time-weighted scoring.

delta.description: Score change from first to last entry

dimensions.description: Flat map of dimension name → score

user_ids.description: External user IDs to look up

ers_correlation.description: Pearson correlation between mood scores and Emotional Readiness Score (-1 to 1)

url.description: HTTPS URL to deliver events to

secret.description: HMAC secret for verifying payload signatures. Store this securely — it is only shown once.

session_id.description: Client-generated session identifier for rate limiting

error.message: text must be at least 20 characters
